caseNameFull: Dandridge, Chairman, Maryland Board of Public Welfare v. Williams
attorneys: Francis B. Burch, Attorney General of Maryland, Robert F. Sweeney, Deputy Attorney General, and George W. Liebmann and Michael McWilliams, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellants.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. Md. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted.
